description: Find verses containing a phrase (case-insensitive substring match) in one translation. Returns up to 50 hits in canonical order with references and links.

limit.description: Maximum number of verses to return, 1 to 50. Default 20.

query.description: Word or phrase to find, 3 to 100 characters. Case-insensitive substring match.

translation.description: Translation code. Default lxx2012 (Septuagint in American English).

name: search_scripture
title: Search scripture
